text: 使用Next.js、FastAPI和Postgres构建ticket-first账单支持工作台；Agent通过后端受控工具调查证据，高风险退款或credit请求必须经过人工审批。
Built a ticket-first billing support workbench with Next.js, FastAPI, and Postgres; the agent investigates through backend-owned tools and routes high-risk mock financial actions to human approval.
设计离线Eval Lab，对最终结果、必需证据、政策合规、审批路由和工作流终态进行确定性评分，并保留可审计Trace。
将受控工具、服务端执行边界和Trace审计模式应用到一个有业务状态和审批约束的Agent工作流。
Implemented FastAPI service boundaries with server-owned RBAC, idempotent workflow commands, Postgres locking, and atomic workflow/approval/mutation/trace writes.
通过Python/FastAPI、Postgres事务和Docker Compose构建可复现后端运行基线，并用数据库并发与容器smoke验证关键路径。
把账单调查、证据面板、审批队列和Eval Lab串成一条可运行的全栈产品路径。
Delivered a coherent Next.js/FastAPI/Postgres product shell where governed Agent actions, evidence, approvals, and audit state are visible in one workbench.
从零实现TypeScript coding-agent Runtime：工具执行先经过allow/ask/deny策略，候选完成还必须通过CompletionGate和verifier。
Built a TypeScript coding-agent Runtime with explicit tool policy and verifier-gated completion, treating model output as a candidate until runtime obligations pass.
实现有界observation、上下文投影与重复压缩，并将Session Trace与模型当前决策视图分离。
Implemented MCP/plugin trust, Worktree-isolated child Sessions, and teammate TaskGraph coordination with actor-owned evidence and Git receipts.
构建13次模型驱动的离线行为回归套件，使用版本化baseline和非补偿式断言；保留当前compaction ordering下降的REGRESSED结果。
补充说明Agent工具权限、验证门和Trace如何约束执行过程，让业务Agent产品的治理机制可解释。
Added runtime-level evidence for permission-scoped tools and bounded context handling to complement MeterDesk's governed business workflow.
Built explicit TypeScript runtime boundaries for tool execution, session state, trace evidence, and verification without hiding orchestration behind a framework.
以TypeScript Runtime的执行边界和工具治理补充MeterDesk的全栈Agent产品落地。
